description.value: Sunnyside Naturals is a health food store in Kaslo, BC, that has served the Kootenay community for 25 years. Situated on Front Street in this small mountain town, the shop offers natural and health foods along with a seasonal prepared-food menu featuring items like cold cucumber soup and quinoa salad. The store's own tagline — "Come, rest your feet" — signals a welcoming attitude toward foot-weary travellers passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page confirms Sunnyside Naturals is a real, operating health food store at 404 Front Street, Kaslo, BC; a May 2025 post celebrates 25 years in business and recent posts about a seasonal prepared-food menu confirm current activity. Contact details (address, phone, email) are drawn from the Facebook About section, as OSM tags carry none. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, or most other cyclist amenities.
concerns: OSM record carries no address, phone, or email tags; all contact details sourced from Facebook About page only.
No dedicated business website found; only a Facebook page is available as the web presence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active health food store with 25 years of operation, confirmed address in Kaslo, and recent social-media activity — a useful resupply stop for cyclists touring the Kootenays.
enrichment_extras.notes: Seasonal prepared-food menu (cold cucumber soup, quinoa salad) mentioned in recent posts; may be of interest to cyclists looking for ready-to-eat options.
